source.citation: Sedra & Smith (2014). Microelectronic Circuits, 7th ed., §17.3. Series RLC band-pass — f0 = 1/(2π√LC), peak gain = 1 for ideal components, BW = R/(2πL).

sim_completed.description: 1 if LTspice AC sweep ran without errors, else 0

peak_freq.description: Frequency at which |V(out)| is maximum (resonant frequency f0)
peak_freq.T_good_source: Closed-form f0 = 1/(2π√(10mH·100nF)) = 5032.9 Hz. Oracle on wine LTspice 26 measures 5011.87 Hz — slight discretization offset from .ac dec 50 (sweep grid). T_good 100 Hz ≈ 2% covers grid granularity.

peak_gain.description: Maximum gain (in dB) over the sweep — gain at resonance. LTspice's .meas AC mag(...) writes magnitude as dB in the .log file, so this number is dB.
peak_gain.T_good_source: For ideal series RLC at resonance, |V_R/V_in| = 1 → 0 dB. Oracle measured -0.012 dB (residual loss from sweep granularity). T_good 0.3 dB ≈ 3.5% linear, T_bad 1.5 dB ≈ 19% linear.
